en: n. an involuntary opening of the mouth wide when you are tired or bored; vi. to open the mouth wide and breathe in deeply, usually because you are tired or bored; to be wide open; vt. to say something while yawning
ex: He tried to hide a yawn during the long meeting.
他在漫長的會議中努力掩飾一個哈欠。

en: vt. to meet someone or something unexpectedly; to experience something difficult or unpleasant; n. an unexpected meeting; a short meeting; vi. to meet by chance
ex: We encountered heavy traffic on the way to the airport.
我們前往機場的路上遇到嚴重塞車。

en: a. extremely strong or great; showing strong feelings; very serious and needing a lot of effort
ex: The heat was so intense that we stayed indoors all day.
高溫非常強烈，我們整天都待在室內。

en: n. the science and technology of electric circuits and devices; electronic equipment such as televisions, computers and phones
ex: He works in a factory that makes consumer electronics.
他在一家生產消費性電子產品的工廠工作。

en: n. a very small living thing that can cause disease; the beginning of something, especially an idea; a seed or part of a plant that can grow into a new one
ex: Washing your hands helps to kill germs.
洗手有助於殺死細菌。

en: n. a person who works in a library, helping people find books and information
ex: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
圖書館員幫我找到一本關於鳥類的書。

en: vt. to put someone or something in danger of being harmed or destroyed
ex: Pollution is endangering many species of fish.
污染正危及許多魚類物種。

en: vi. to go down on your knees; to place one or both knees on the ground, especially as a sign of respect
ex: She knelt down to pick up the child's toy.
她跪下去撿起孩子的玩具。

en: n. a high steep rock face, especially at the edge of the sea
ex: The hikers stopped at the edge of the cliff to enjoy the view.
健行者在懸崖邊停下來欣賞景色。
ph: on the edge of a cliff

en: n. the act of making something new; something that has been created; the universe and all things in it; the act of causing something to exist
ex: The creation of the new park took two years.
新公園的興建花了兩年。

en: n. the quality of being very strong or extreme; the amount of power, force or energy of something; the strength of a feeling
ex: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.
暴風雨的強度讓每個人都很驚訝。

en: n. the act of making something smaller in size, amount or price; a lower price; a smaller copy of something
ex: The store offered a ten percent reduction on all items.
商店所有商品都打九折。

en: n. the flat, sharp part of a knife, sword or tool that is used for cutting; a thin, flat leaf of grass; the flat part of an oar, a propeller or a fan
ex: The blade of the knife was very sharp.
那把刀的刀刃非常鋒利。

en: n. the right to keep your personal life and information secret; the state of being alone and not disturbed by other people; the state of being private
ex: Everyone has a right to privacy.
每個人都有隱私權。

en: n. a tool or machine used for making holes; a training exercise repeated many times; a series of practice exercises, such as those done by firefighters or soldiers; v. to make a hole with a drill; to teach someone by repeated exercises
ex: The students did a fire drill at school this morning.
學生們今天早上在學校進行了消防演習。

en: n. a person who carries messages or documents from one person or place to another; a person who delivers news
ex: The messenger delivered an important letter to the king.
信使把一封重要的信送給國王。

en: vi. to divide into two or more parts; to break along a line; vt. to divide something into parts; to share something; n. a break or crack; a division in a group of people; a. divided or broken
ex: They decided to split the bill equally.
他們決定平分帳單。

en: n. a root with a strong, hot taste used in cooking and medicine; a reddish-brown color; energy or spirit; a. having a reddish-brown color; vt. to flavor something with ginger
ex: She added fresh ginger to the soup for extra flavor.
她在湯裡加了新鮮的薑增添風味。

en: vt. to remove something completely; to get rid of something that is not wanted; to defeat someone in a competition so that they cannot continue
ex: The company plans to eliminate waste in its production process.
公司計畫消除生產過程中的浪費。

en: a. willing to do what you are told to do by someone in authority; willing to follow rules or orders
ex: The dog is very obedient and always comes when called.
那隻狗很聽話，叫牠就會過來。

en: n. a sum of money that is paid back to someone, especially when goods are returned; the act of returning money; vt. to pay back money that someone has spent; vi. to give back money
ex: I asked the store for a refund because the shirt didn't fit.
我向店家要求退款，因為這件襯衫不合身。

en: n. giving up something important for a particular purpose; something valuable that you give up; an offering made to a god; vt. to give up something for another person or purpose; to sell something at a loss; vi. to make an offering to a god
ex: Parents often make big sacrifices for their children.
父母經常為孩子做出重大的犧牲。

en: n. something that you can choose instead of something else; a choice between two or more things; a. different from the usual or traditional one; providing a choice
ex: We need to find an alternative to using plastic bags.
我們需要找到替代塑膠袋的辦法。

en: n. a strong building or group of buildings used for defense; a military base; a place for trading in the past; vt. to protect a place with a fort
ex: The old fort stands on a hill overlooking the sea.
這座古堡矗立在俯瞰大海的山丘上。

en: a. having no money at all; (past tense of break) did break; (of a machine) not working
ex: I can't go out this weekend because I'm broke.
我這週末不能出門，因為我身無分文。

en: v. to say that you think something or someone is bad or wrong; to judge something by pointing out its good and bad points
ex: The newspaper criticized the government's new policy.
報紙批評了政府的新政策。

en: n. behavior, especially of children, that is slightly bad but not usually serious; harm or damage; the cause of trouble; an annoying person
ex: The children were full of mischief during the party.
孩子們在派對上調皮搗蛋。

en: vt. to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty; to defeat someone or something; to affect someone very strongly; vi. to win
ex: She overcame her fear of speaking in public.
她克服了公開演講的恐懼。

en: a. based on clear and sensible reasoning; using or following the rules of logic; reasonable or natural in a particular situation
ex: It is logical to assume that prices will rise next year.
假設明年物價會上漲是合理的。

en: n. the way that words are used in a language; the act of using something; the amount of something that is used; the way in which something is treated
ex: This dictionary gives examples of English usage.
這本字典提供了英語用法的例子。

en: n. a person who buys and sells goods in large quantities, especially from other countries; a shopkeeper; a. relating to trade or commerce
ex: The merchant sold silk and spices at the market.
商人在市場上賣絲綢和香料。

en: n. a person of the same age, status or ability as you; a member of the nobility in Britain; vi. to look carefully, especially when it is difficult to see; to appear slowly
ex: Teenagers are often influenced by their peers.
青少年常受到同儕的影響。

en: n. the ability to do something well without wasting time, money or energy; the ratio of useful work done to the energy used
ex: The new software has improved our efficiency a great deal.
新軟體大幅提升了我們的效率。

en: a. used for protecting someone or something from attack; behaving in a way that shows you feel you are being criticized; n. a position or attitude of protection
ex: He became defensive when we asked about his mistake.
我們問起他的錯誤時，他變得很防衛。

en: n. a holiday taken by a couple who have just got married; the early period of a relationship when everything is happy; vi. to go on a honeymoon
ex: They went to Hawaii for their honeymoon.
他們去夏威夷度蜜月。

en: n. a person who tells lies
ex: Nobody believed him because he was known as a liar.
沒人相信他，因為他是出了名的說謊者。

en: n. a child whose parents are dead; a. having no parents; vt. to cause a child to lose both parents
ex: The orphan was raised by his grandmother.
這位孤兒由祖母撫養長大。

en: vt. to keep something because it is important to you; to take care of something or someone because you love them; to hold something such as a hope in your mind
ex: I will always cherish the memories of our trip.
我會永遠珍惜我們旅行的回憶。

en: n. a person who has killed another person illegally; a person who commits murder
ex: The police finally caught the murderer after a long investigation.
警方經過長期調查，終於抓到了兇手。

en: n. a small circle or spiral of hair; a curved shape; vt. to twist something into a curl or spiral shape; vi. to form a curl or spiral; to move in a curving way
ex: She has long, curly hair and wears it in loose curls.
她留著長長的捲髮，鬆鬆地捲起來。
